sentences.en: The low-risk investment is perfect for someone who doesn't want to take big chances.
sentences.zh: 这种低风险的投资非常适合那些不想冒大风险的人。

sentences.en: She chose a low-risk surgery because she was afraid of complications.
sentences.zh: 她选择了低风险的手术，因为害怕出现并发症。

sentences.en: The company offers low-risk options for those looking to save money on insurance.
sentences.zh: 这家公司为那些希望在保险上节省开支的人提供低风险的选择。
